title: Backpropagation as Dirac-bracket dynamics of dissipative training
abstract: arXiv:2611.34479v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Gradient-based training of a parametric model is the motion of a damped particle in the potential set by the loss. Using the Bateman-Galley doubling of the degrees of freedom, which gives dissipative systems an action principle, we write gradient flow, the heavy-ball method and Nesterov's accelerated gradient method as Hamiltonian systems. We show that, within this Hamiltonian description, backpropagation is Dirac evolution. The activations of a feed-forward network are treated as coordinates of phase space, and the layer equations as constraints. These constraints are second class for every architecture, and Hamilton's equations with the resulting Dirac bracket reproduce training with the exact gradient of the loss, although the Hamiltonian contains only the cost of the network output. translated_title: 反向传播作为耗散训练的狄拉克括号动力学
translated_abstract: 基于梯度的参数化模型训练可以看作是阻尼粒子在由损失函数设定的势场中的运动。利用 Bateman-Galley 自由度倍增方法（该方法赋予耗散系统一个作用量原理），我们将梯度流、重球法和 Nesterov 加速梯度方法写成哈密顿系统。我们证明，在这一哈密顿描述中，反向传播就是狄拉克演化。前馈网络的激活值被视为相空间的坐标，层方程被视为约束。对于任何网络架构，这些约束都是第二类约束，而带有由此得到的狄拉克括号的哈密顿方程重现了使用损失函数精确梯度的训练过程，尽管哈密顿量中只包含网络输出的代价。激活值与参数动量之间的狄拉克括号正是其雅可比矩阵，而约束矩阵的逆同时包含了前向传播……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文通过 Bateman-Galley 自由度倍增将耗散的梯度训练方法（梯度流、重球法、Nesterov 加速梯度）表述为哈密顿系统，并把网络激活值视为第二类约束，证明反向传播本质上是狄拉克括号演化，从而为反向传播给出了严格的哈密顿力学几何解释。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates dissipative gradient-based training methods (gradient flow, heavy-ball, and Nesterov's accelerated gradient) as Hamiltonian systems via Bateman-Galley doubling, and shows that backpropagation is exactly Dirac-bracket evolution arising from treating network activations as second-class constraints, providing a rigorous Hamiltonian-geometric interpretation of backpropagation.
